# Shared data (generated by ../gen_data.py, fixed seed 20261021, deterministic)

All apps read these files instead of embedding data. Regenerate: `python3 gen_data.py`.

| File | Format |
|---|---|
| profiles.json | `{selected, profiles:[{id,name,mc_version,loader(fabric/forge/quilt/vanilla),mods,ram_mb,last_played ISO}]}` 8 profiles |
| chat.json | `{selected, contacts:[{id,name,initials,color,unread}] x6, messages:[{id,contact,from_me,text,ts ISO}] x40}` |
| files.tsv | header + 100000 rows, tab separated: `name size(bytes) date(YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM) type folder` |
| tree.json | `{name, children:[{name, files, children}]}` folder tree for files app (8 top folders) |
| notes.md | Markdown: headings, bold, italic, lists, code block, links |
| notes_list.json | `{selected, notes:[{id,title,file,modified}] x5}` (note 1 = notes.md) |
| metrics.json | `{kpis x4, line_90d x90 {date,value}, bars_12 {label,value}, donut x4 {label,share}, events x8, ranges, default_range}` |
| settings.json | pages + defaults for the 5 settings pages |
| form.json | wizard steps, `valid` and `invalid` test input, validation rules |

Default screenshot state: first item selected everywhere, no hover, 1100x700, DPR 1.

## Harness conventions (for app workers)
- Every app needs `--theme light|dark` and `--shot <file.png>` (1 stable frame, 1100x700, exit).
- **flei is a VISUAL rebuild only (fake data, no backend)**; the original's lines count only as UI code
  (Svelte views/components + CSS, no Rust backend).
- Register an app for measuring: `apps/<app>/<toolkit>/measure.json` (see run_all.py docstring):
  `{"cmd":"/abs/app --theme {theme} --shot {shot}","src":["/abs/src"],"size_paths":["/abs/bin"],"build_cmd":"...","input":"click:550,350;key:Tab"}`
  `{shot}`/`{theme}` are replaced by the harness; interactive cmd = cmd without `--shot` (or give `run_cmd`).
- Shots: `shots/<app>-<toolkit>-<light|dark>.png` (app flei|chat|settings|dash|files|form|notes; toolkit fui|web|egui|gtk|qt; flei reference = `flei-original-<theme>.png`).
- Optional frame hook: if env `UIVGL_FRAMES` is set, the interactive app may write JSON `{"scroll_ms":..,"resize_ms":..,"anim_ms":..}`.
- Tools: `python3 loc.py <files/dirs>` (lines), `python3 measure.py ...`, `python3 compare.py --table`, `python3 gallery.py`, `./run_all.sh`.
